image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is curled up on a gray, textured rock surface. The salamander displays the characteristic black and yellow warning coloration with irregular yellow spots and bands on a glossy black body. The salamander is positioned in a curved posture with its head visible on the right side and its tail wrapping around its body. The rock surface appears rough and natural, providing a contrasting background to the salamander's vivid coloration.
